method.arms: The original fills the rest of its 1024 canvas with black. Edge extends its last rows and columns. Reflect mirrors its border without repeating the boundary pixel. Both accepts an edge component only if at least two thirds of each component overlap in the edge and reflect views, and preserves existing flags.
method.fixed_source: All decoded source pixels, source location, geometry graph, native response threshold, source area rule and reliable-grid component rules match the existing JPEG75 comparison.
method.transfer: A proposal needs at least three added useful groups from two editors, with no lost useful location and at most two newly flagged ordinary groups. The source panel had prior exposure.
method.useful: At least 0.30 IoU and 0.50 exact pre-encode changed-pixel recall.
